title.narrative: Supporting Rwanda Towards Reducing TB and HIV-related Morbidity and Mortality

description.narrative: Rwanda - TB/HIV - Ministry of Health of the Republic of Rwanda - Ministry of health. This program has the following goals: New HIV infections are reduced by 2024. HIV related deaths and comorbidities are reduced and HIV morbidity is decreased. People infected and affected by HIV have the same opportunities as the general population. 57% reduction in TB deaths (compared with 2015) by 2024. 35% reduction in TB incidence rate (compared with 2015) by 2024. TBD affected families facing catastrophic costs due to tuberculosis. The objectives of this program are: To enhance surveillance at community, ports of entry and at health facilities. New infection in children are maintained below 5%. New HIV infections by sexual transmission reduced. To improve sample collection and referral mechanisms, and laboratory testing/diagnostic capacities. The coverage of ART and the VL suppression among PLHIV on treatment are increased. To improve infection prevention & control for COVID-19 in all health facilities. To improve clinical capacities of hospitals to manage COVID-19 cases. PLHIV have reduced morbidity related to STI, OI and other co-morbidities. People infected and affected by HIV and MVC have improved socio-economic status and protection. SGBV and HIV related stigma and discrimination are reduced. Considering the Patient Pathway for Tuberculosis. Targeted approaches for key drivers of TB epidemic and selected populations. Programme management, multi-Sectoral collaboration & engaging all care providers. Universal Health Coverage, social protection, human rights & gender, nutrition. Stable and quality assured supply of drugs, diagnostics and commodities. M&E and data quality system (e-TB, health information system, Civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS) system
